law_name: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
law_name_original: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
text_en:
In order to efficiently operate the postal insurance business under the Postal Savings and Insurance Act , Special Accounts for Postal Insurance shall be established, and the revenue of the Accounts shall be appropriated for the expenditure of the Accounts.
[This Article Wholly Amended on Jan. 30, 2009]

law_name: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
law_name_original: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
text_en:
A postal insurance reserve (hereinafter referred to as "reserve") shall be created separately from the revenue and expenditure in order to appropriate it for the liability reserve for the payment of insurance proceeds, refunds, and other insurance benefits.
The reserve shall be raised from the following revenues:
Net insurance premiums (referring to the insurance premiums less additional insurance premiums);
Gains on the operation of the reserve;
Surpluses after the settlement of the revenue and expenditure of the Accounts.
Insurance proceeds, refunds, and other insurance benefits shall be disbursed from the reserve.
[This Article Wholly Amended on Jan. 30, 2009]

law_name: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
law_name_original: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
text_en:
Article 8 (Preparation of reports on settlement of accounts and appropriation of surpluses)
The Minister of Science and ICT may prepare a report on settlement of accounts (including the reserve) in accordance with Acts and subordinate statutes relevant to corporate budgeting and accounting for each fiscal year in addition to the report on the settlement of the Accounts prepared pursuant to the National Accounting Act . <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013; Jul. 26, 2017>
If any surplus remains after the settlement of the revenue and expenditure of the Accounts for each fiscal year, it shall be appropriated for compensating carried-over deficits, and the remainder, if any, shall be set aside for the reserve.
The Minister of Science and ICT may appropriate part of the surpluses left over after the settlement of the reserve for public projects for insurance policy holders and social minorities. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013; Jul. 26, 2017>
Necessary matters regarding the scope of public projects under paragraph (3) and the procurement of financial resources therefor shall be prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Science and ICT. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013; Jul. 26, 2017>
[This Article Wholly Amended on Jan. 30, 2009]

law_name_original: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
text_en:
If it is necessary to reimburse expenses for the Accounts, long-term loans or temporary loans may be borrowed at the expense of the Accounts.
Temporary loans under paragraph (1) shall be repaid with the revenue for the pertinent fiscal year.

law_name: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
law_name_original: ACT ON SPECIAL ACCOUNT FOR POSTAL INSURANCE
text_en:
Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Act shall enter into force on March 1, 2000.
Article 2 (Transitional measures following change of name of Postal Insurance Fund)
The former Postal Insurance Fund existing as at the time this Act enters into force shall be construed as the Postal Insurance Fund under this Act.
Funds deposited in the Public Capital Management Fund from the Postal Insurance Fund pursuant to Article 6 of the Public Capital Management Fund Act as at the time this Act enters into force shall be construed as funds deposited in the Public Capital Management Fund from the Postal Insurance Fund under this Act.
Article 3 Omitted.
